openPRs.title: fix: Fix mongodb launch issue
openPRs.author: qbyte2
openPRs.body:
## Summary
- Fix MongoDB connection not initializing in non-production environments when `MONGODB_URL` is set
- Store `mongoUrl` in instance variable and use it in `onModuleInit` condition check so MongoDB connects whenever the URL is configured, regardless of `NODE_ENV`

## Changes
- `src/logging/mongo.service.ts`: Added `mongoUrl` instance variable; updated `onModuleInit` condition to also connect when `this.mongoUrl` is truthy

openPRs.title: docs(KAT-7716): Merchant → Catalog rename design and implementation plans
openPRs.author: feng-1m
openPRs.body:
## Summary

- Design doc and three-phase implementation plans for renaming Merchant → Catalog (where Merchant means catalog/shop)
- Phase A: Schema renames, module consolidation, backward-compatible API layer (12 tasks)
- Phase B: Cleanup deprecated aliases after FE migration (8 tasks)
- Phase C: Add merchantId (User ref) to core tables for direct seller queries (8 tasks)
- FE migration guide covering all phases: 41 route changes, request/response field renames, enum updates, Phase C performance

openPRs.title: feat(user-activity): Remove UserActivity table and migrate to MongoDB
openPRs.author: wgcairui
openPRs.body:
## Summary
- Remove UserActivity Prisma model and migrate to MongoDB-only storage
- Delete UserActivityRepository class (no longer needed)
- Add GDPR-compliant PII sanitization for checkout data
- Preserve enums for backward compatibility

## Changes
- **Schema**: Removed `UserActivity` model from `schema.prisma`
- **Repository**: Deleted `UserActivityRepository` (replaced by MongoDB direct writes)
- **Service**: Updated `UserActivityService` to return plain objects instead of Prisma entities
